definitions.explanation: An optical instrument for viewing very small objects.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}を{使|つか}う。
{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}で{細胞|さいぼう}を{観察|かんさつ}する。
examples.english: To observe cells under a microscope.

examples.japanese: {顕微鏡|けんびきょう}の{倍率|ばいりつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: To adjust the magnification of the microscope.

notes:
{顕微鏡|けんびきょう} is an optical instrument for viewing objects too small to see with the naked eye.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {顕|けん}: manifest, reveal
- {微|び}: minute, tiny
- {鏡|きょう}: mirror, lens

TYPES:
- {光学|こうがく}{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}: optical/light microscope
- {電子|でんし}{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}: electron microscope
- {実体|じったい}{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}: stereomicroscope

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {顕微鏡|けんびきょう}で{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe under a microscope
- {顕微鏡|けんびきょう}を{覗|のぞ}く: to look through a microscope
- {倍率|ばいりつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust magnification

RELATED:
- {望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}: telescope (for distant objects)
- {虫眼鏡|むしめがね}: magnifying glass
